data.title: 雷电将军 · 天守阁晨茶私享
data.description: 清晨的天守阁静谧无声，晨曦透过细竹帘在榻榻米上投下斑驳光影。影独自跪坐在矮几前，修身高领黑色无袖毛衣衬出优雅颈项与沉静身形。她双手端着热气袅袅的煎茶，紫眸微抬看向面前之人，眸底流转着卸下神明威严后的温和柔光；细碎的紫电如同灵动火花，在茶汽与垂落的长发间轻盈跃动。
data.action: 在天守阁矮几前端庄跪坐，双手捧着热茶，神态宁静柔和，直视前方凝望观众
data.lighting: 竹帘透入的清晨柔光与紫色电弧微光
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, eye level medium shot, compact kneeling pose
data.mood: 威严卸下后的静谧与私享温存
data.promptProse: Ei kneels before the low table facing the viewer in her black open-side virgin killer sweater, delicate collarbone and alluring sideboob catching the morning light; she holds a warm teacup with both hands as purple sparks dance gently in the tea steam.
data.animaCaption: Facing the viewer at the low table, her black open-side sweater highlights her sideboob, collarbone, and bare thighs as she holds warm tea.
